The metallic lever on the left merges indistinctly into the body of the typewriter. The connection point is vague, and the geometry of the handle seems to melt slightly into the air/background without a clear pivot point.

The alignment of the keys follows a curve that feels slightly inconsistent with the rigid straight lines of the typewriter's front edge, suggesting minor geometric warping common in AI generations of complex mechanical objects.
